proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_lifecycle.becomes_nonmagical_on_hit
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item surface can encode the passive attack and damage bonuses, but it cannot encode a successful-hit lifecycle that removes the item's magic while leaving the ammunition itself present.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.”

notes: Authored as a three-variant passive magic-item collection for the rarity-based bonuses. The post-hit loss of magic is omitted from the authored subset and recorded as a surface gap.
